notes: Summary: Large global 3PL exploring LLM to augment operations dashboards, customer chat, and run-time reranking for route optimization. Strong interest in Dedicated or Private deployment due to data residency and regulatory customers.

Primary technical concern: burst traffic (end-of-day planning windows + sudden customer spikes) causes queueing in our POC. They want hard guarantees for tail latency under 5s for interactive chat and consistent throughput for batch reranking jobs.

POC recap (Dec 2025): ran 2-week evaluation on dedicated pool with auto-burst enabled (3x). Steady-state throughput met SLA, but simulated end-of-day surge produced queueing and token throttling; 12–18s tail latencies on peak tests.
Their infra team: "We can tolerate short stalls for low-priority jobs but customer-facing chat must stay sub-5s."

Security review: SOC2 and KMS integration sign-off done; data residency question unresolved — EU customers require EU-only keys (they push Private). Security asked for audit log retention policy + HSM diagrams (submitted on 2026-01-05).
Commercial friction: procurement hit a budget freeze in Q1; competitor (Anthropic) offered bundled credits + temporary burst pool at a discount — CFO leaned toward lower short-term cost.
Champion status: Head of ML (M. Rinaldi) moved to a new role in Jan; no clear internal sponsor now. Platform lead (S. Patel) is busy with ERP migration, low responsiveness.

SE notes: we underestimated queueing from heterogeneous batch jobs (long sequence reranks interleaving with chat). Need a per-tenant priority queue + preemptive scaling policy in proposal. Suggested experiment: isolated high-priority queue + lightweight KV cache warms to reduce token cost during surges.

What we offered: dedicated GPU pool with configurable burst lanes, canary fallback to smaller chat-optimized model, 72-hour guaranteed response time for ops escalations. Proposed detailed capacity plan (drive://redwood/prod-pricing/orion-proposal-v2).
Customer feedback quote: "If you can't prove consistent tail latency during our end-of-day window, it's a non-starter. Anthropic told us they run multi-tenant burst lanes that won't queue."
